rationale: All three REHEARSAL_COMPLETE conditions are satisfied and no REHEARSAL_INCOMPLETE condition applies. (1) The lifecycle ran end to end on full-year TRAIN 2023 / OOS 2024: the controller card records actions smoke, collection, reconcile, merge, fit, freeze, oos, analyze with STATUS OK, state READY_TO_CLOSE, 137 tests passed / 0 failed; the seal binds a CLEAR causal audit and a CLEAR contract audit (pass 02, 0 critical / 0 warning) to execution composite 73db2ed0f213, and every downstream artifact carries that same composite and plan_sha256 9eb2ff0d6e63. (2) The fitted feature surface is EXACTLY the three ratified single-arm instances, expanded to four physical columns (prior_1m_regime_efficiency, prior_5m_regime_efficiency, rolling_300s_giveback_atr, structural_max_expansion_atr) -- identical in compiled_plan.json, experiment_models.json, train_experiment_freeze.json and the scored-frame model_scores inputs; the withdrawn structural_max_expansion_checkpoint_atr appears nowhere in the compiled plan, and nothing was renamed, substituted or re-parameterized. (3) tail_lift.json exists, is computed on the study's OWN fitted model d3cfd7621897 (golden authentication PASS, max_abs_diff 0.0), with thresholds taken as quantiles of the TRAIN reference frame (n_reference = 877040 rows, years [2023]) and applied to OOS 2024 rows (n_rows = 859153 of 867422 scored), per the tail_lift op contract. Scientifically the single arm shows OOS tail lift over base rate 0.3271: 1.531 at the TRAIN P90 threshold, 1.701 at P95, 1.977 at P97.5. This decision claims NO comparison between the checkpoint-epoch and frozen-ATR normalizations; that question has no comparator frame in this study and remains open.

caveats: SINGLE ARM. The checkpoint-epoch normalization was withdrawn (unregistered capability, capability flow ended in SUPERVISOR_ESCALATION_REQUIRED, owner intervention). Nothing here compares the two normalizations; the original question remains OPEN.

Row-level, not episode-level. 859153 evaluable OOS rows come from 6680 regime episodes (~130 five-second checkpoints each), so the effective independent sample is thousands of episodes, not hundreds of thousands of rows. No confidence interval is declared or claimed, and no entity-level metric was declared.

Pooled across direction and maturity. The declared analysis has group_by=null, so long/short and young/mature regimes are pooled. Re-slicing after seeing OOS is prohibited, so an inverted slice would be invisible here.
rolling_300s_giveback_atr is null on roughly three quarters of rows; LightGBM routes NaN natively, so the column contributes mainly through its non-null quarter.

The label is a 300s forward flip of the same regime tracker that defines the population, evaluated on a 5s cadence, so adjacent rows share overlapping horizons. That is by design for the rehearsal but makes a row-level lift optimistic as a test statistic.

experiment_models.json echoes the hyperparameters without random_state, which compiled_plan.json model.params does declare (42). Determinism is additionally pinned by deterministic:true and n_jobs:1, and the golden replay reproduces scores exactly.

At decision time studies/rehearsal_checkpoint_norm/artifacts/ is still untracked in git. This worker's write surface is analysis_decision.json/.md only, so the evidence files are pinned here by sha256 instead; the closing session should commit them.
No economic result is claimed. Tail lift is a classification-tail statistic, not a tradeable edge; nothing here has been through fills, costs or a live-style NT run.
what_would_change_the_verdict: A declared deliverable missing, or its on-disk digest disagreeing with experiment_analysis_v2.json
The fitted feature surface differing from the four ratified columns (an instance dropped, renamed, substituted or re-parameterized)
Any claim of the checkpoint-vs-frozen normalization contrast appearing in the study record
A stage or gate found to have been skipped, or an audit verdict other than CLEAR at the sealed composite
